chunks.title: About Siddharth Rai - Who I Am
chunks.text: I’m Siddharth Rai (Sid)—originally from Bhopal, currently based in Bengaluru. By day, I’m at Accenture reverse-engineering Android malware and building internal LLM/RAG automation workflows that cut repetitive triage work out of the pipeline. Right now, I’m looking to transition into a high-ownership **Applied AI or Agentic AI** role, but I am also open to other opportunities.

chunks.title: About Siddharth Rai - How I Work & Think
chunks.text:
- **Execution Over Buzzwords:** I’m a pragmatic problem solver and process optimizer. I don't care about sticking to a single stack or trend—I’ll use whatever tool, script, or workaround gets the job done reliably.
- **Reverse-Engineer’s Mindset:** I prefer understanding how things actually work under the hood rather than accepting black-box abstractions—whether that’s decompiling Android bytecode, tweaking Linux kernel configs, or squeezing multi-agent workflows onto an 8GB VRAM laptop.
- **Low-Friction Habits:** I practice intentional digital minimalism (keeping distraction apps off my primary phone so I can actually focus) and automate repetitive tasks wherever I spot them.
- **Communication Style:** Candid, approachable, and comfortable speaking in front of a crowd—zero tolerance for corporate fluff or unnecessary red tape.

chunks.title: About Siddharth Rai - Outside Work
chunks.text:
- **Music:** I play electric guitar (mostly heavy metal and drop-tuned riffs) alongside acoustic guitar, ukulele, and synth—usually routing everything through Reaper and Neural DSP amp sims.
- **Tinkering & Homelab:** I run a self-hosted Ubuntu Linux homelab, decompile personal APKs to strip out telemetry, and build ESP32 hardware automations to fix minor annoyances around my apartment.
- **Motorcycle enthusiast:** I ride and maintain my motorcycle. I am not scared to open my bike up and fix it. 
- **Downtime & Reading:** PC gaming, social deduction games at board game parties, Star Wars (Darth Vader and Stormtroopers are literally running this desktop).
- **Fuel:** Strictly zero caffeine and just early mornings, gym sessions, and the occasional cup of tea.

chunks.title: Secure Immich Server - Overview
chunks.text:
**Secure Immich Server** is a self-hosted personal photo cloud built on Immich with a strict zero-public-exposure design. Running on a repurposed 2019 gaming laptop with Ubuntu LTS, it gives me cloud-style photo management (facial detection, smart search, mobile backups) while keeping complete data sovereignty and zero third-party cloud dependence.

- **GitHub:** https://github.com/HiSiddharth/SecureImmichServer
- **Medium Write-up:** https://medium.com/@hisiddharth/building-a-private-photo-cloud-security-first-design-for-self-hosted-immich-163838838e65

chunks.title: Secure Immich Server - Why I Built It
chunks.text: Rising cloud subscription fees, privacy concerns over personal media, and the friction of managing manual encrypted hard-drive backups led me to build a centralized, private system I control operationally and technically—avoiding duplicate files, accidental losses, and clunky backup workflows.

chunks.title: Secure Immich Server - Architecture & Security Hardening
chunks.text:
- **Zero Public Exposure & VPN-Only Access:** WireGuard (on a non-standard port with manual peer management and periodic key rotation) is the only exposed service; SSH and web access require VPN authentication.
- **Defense-in-Depth Network & Reverse Proxy:** Nginx listens only on the WireGuard interface and proxies to Immich bound to `127.0.0.1` over self-signed TLS, while Immich runs via Docker Compose on a bridge network (`immich_default`) with no host networking.
- **Hostile-by-Default Firewall:** UFW defaults to deny across inbound, outbound, and routed traffic, allowing only WireGuard, SSH over WireGuard, and necessary container egress.
- **LUKS Encryption at Rest & Lifecycle Scripts:** Photo storage sits on a LUKS-encrypted partition unlocked manually on startup and checked against active Immich jobs before graceful shutdown, unmounting, and re-locking—keeping encryption keys out of persistent disk storage.
- **Hardware UPS & Monitoring:** Kept plugged in with charge capped at 60%, monitored every 5 minutes via cron to trigger a safe shutdown if discharging below 30%, paired with deliberate manual updates to reduce supply-chain risk.

chunks.title: The AI Loom - Overview
chunks.text:
**The AI Loom** is a local-first, multi-model coding orchestrator built with Python, LangGraph, and LM Studio. Instead of forcing a single local model to handle everything, it splits **Planning**, **Implementation**, and **Verification** across specialized models—dynamically swapping them in and out of GPU VRAM so multi-agent engineering loops run reliably on consumer hardware (like an RTX 4060 with 8GB VRAM).

- **GitHub:** https://github.com/HiSiddharth/The-AI-Loom

chunks.title: The AI Loom - How It Works
chunks.text:
1. **Planner Node (`Qwen 3.5 9B`):** Decomposes a high-level user objective into a structured task plan.
2. **VRAM Swap (`9B` → `4B`):** Explicitly unloads the 9B model via LM Studio's REST API before loading the worker model to stay within tight VRAM limits.
3. **Worker Node (`Qwen 3 4B Thinking`):** Generates code for each task, executes scripts via `subprocess` inside `./sandbox`, and feeds captured `stderr` tracebacks and prior code back into retry loops on failure.
4. **VRAM Swap (`4B` → `9B`):** Unloads the worker once tasks finish and reloads the 9B model.
5. **Verifier Node (`Qwen 3.5 9B`):** Reviews the generated code alongside actual execution outputs, issuing either `STATUS: APPROVED` or `STATUS: REVISE` (looping back to the Planner up to `MAX_MANAGER_RETRIES`).

chunks.title: The AI Loom - Key Engineering Details
chunks.text:
- **Dynamic VRAM Lifecycle Management (`hardware.py`):** Interacts directly with LM Studio's `/api/v0/models` and `/api/v1/models/{load,unload}` endpoints to prevent out-of-memory crashes on single-GPU setups.
- **Stateful LangGraph Pipeline (`graph.py`, `nodes.py`):** Coordinates conditional routing, sequential code generation, bounded retries, and manager review loops.
- **Execution-Grounded Self-Correction:** Validates code by running it rather than relying solely on static LLM self-reflection.
- **Thinking-Model Output Sanitization:** Strips `<think>...</think>` reasoning blocks before parsing JSON task plans, Python code blocks, or verification verdicts.
- **Observability:** Streams node transitions, VRAM swap timings, execution logs, and review verdicts to `stdout` and `./sandbox/platform.log`.

chunks.title: The AI Loom - Current Scope & Roadmap
chunks.text:
- **Current Constraints:** Scripts run directory-scoped (`cwd="./sandbox"`) via `subprocess` rather than full OS/container isolation, and individual files are validated sequentially via `python <filename>`.
- **Planned for v1.0:** Ephemeral Docker container sandboxing (`--network none`), automated `pytest` and linter validation inside the Worker loop, Tree-sitter repo indexing with SQLite project memory, and OpenCode CLI integration.

chunks.title: REvolver (Resume Evolver) - Overview
chunks.text:
**REvolver (Resume Evolver)** is a zero-cost, serverless AI resume-tailoring workflow built entirely inside the Google Ecosystem. Instead of manually editing resumes for every application or paying for SaaS wrappers, it pairs a structured Google Sheets career database with Google Apps Script, Google Docs templates, OpenRouter APIs, and a browser bookmarklet to generate tailored resumes in seconds.

- **GitHub:** https://github.com/HiSiddharth/REvolver

chunks.title: REvolver (Resume Evolver) - How It Works
chunks.text:
1. **Capture on Any Job Board:** Highlight a job description on any webpage and click the **Tailor Resume** browser bookmarklet.
2. **Verify Context:** Confirm or tweak the auto-extracted company name, job title, and job description inside the injected modal overlay.
3. **Serverless Selection & Generation:** Google Apps Script queries OpenRouter (`google/gemini-2.5-flash` by default) against the master career database to select and tailor the most relevant entries.
4. **Template Population & Cleanup:** Injects the tailored content into a formatted Google Docs template (`{{EXP_%d_ROLE}}`, `{{PROJECT_%d_TITLE}}`, `{{SKILL_GROUP_%d_SKILLS}}`, etc.), automatically stripping unused placeholder blocks so formatting stays clean.
5. **Instant Redirect:** Saves the finished resume to a target Google Drive folder and redirects the browser straight to the generated document.

chunks.title: REvolver (Resume Evolver) - Architecture & Components
chunks.text:
- **Master Career Database (Google Sheets):** Single `Database` tab storing categorized career history (`Exp`, `prj`, `Crt`, `skills`, `por`), tech stacks, links, and `Duplicate Group` tags to prevent redundant entries from being picked together.
- **Dynamic Document Engine (Google Docs + Apps Script):** Uses `Code.js` and `Index.html` deployed as an Apps Script Web App, pulling external system prompts (`PROMPT_DOC_ID`) and API keys from Script Properties so logic and prompts can be updated without redeploying code.
- **Zero-Extension Browser Trigger (`bookmarklet.js`):** Minified `javascript:` payload (with a Python helper script for minification) that works directly from the bookmarks bar without needing browser extension permissions.
